data.name: Charisiel
data.gender_notes: Charisiel is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Charisiel is derived from the Hebrew words 'Chara' (grace) and 'El' (God). It is a unisex name that signifies the grace or blessing bestowed by God. The name Charisiel carries the meaning “Grace of God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Charisiel usually hope their child will grow to embody grace of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of God's divine grace and love.
data.etymology: Charisiel belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Grace of God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Charisiel total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_hebrew.name: כריסיאל
in_hebrew.meaning: כריסיאל - חסד אלוהים, מתנה משמיים, חסד אל
in_hebrew.long_meaning: כריסיאל הוא שם המשלב את המילים היווניות 'χάρις' (חסד) ו'אל' (אלוהים). הוא מתאר את המתנה האלוהית של חסד ורחמים, המוענקת לבני אדם. השם נושא משמעות עמוקה של אהבה וקבלה אלוהית, ומוצא את שורשיו בברית החדשה ובמסורת הנוצרית.

in_greek.name: Χαρισιέλ
in_greek.meaning: Χαρισιέλ - χάρις του Θεού, δωροῦν του Θεού
in_greek.long_meaning: Το Χαρισιέλ είναι όνομα που συνδυάζει τις λέξεις 'χάρις' (χάρις, χάρι) και 'Θεός' (Θεός, Θεός). Εκφράζει το δώρο της θείας χάριτος και συμπονίας προς τους ανθρώπους. Το όνομα αυτό φέρει βαθιά σημασία της θείας αγάπης και αποδοχής και έχει τις ρίζες του στη Νέα Διαθήκη και την χριστιανική παράδοση.

in_latin.name: Charisiel
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Charisiel significat donum Dei, seu gratia Dei. Hoc nomen profundam habet significationem amoris et acceptationis divinae, et in traditione christiana et Novo Testamento fundatur. Est compositum ex vocabulis graecis 'χάρις' (gratia) et 'אל' seu 'Deus', quod est donum caeleste a Deo datum hominibus.

in_english.name: Charisiel
in_english.meaning: Charisiel - Gift of God, Divine Grace, Heavenly Present
in_english.long_meaning: The name Charisiel originates from the Greek words 'χάρις' (charis), meaning 'grace' or 'favor', and 'אל' or 'Deus', signifying 'God'. It denotes the divine gift of grace and mercy bestowed upon humanity. Charisiel carries a profound meaning of God's love and acceptance, rooted in New Testament teachings and Christian tradition. This name symbolizes spiritual blessings and heavenly gifts, reflecting a deep connection with faith and divine providence.

data.cultural_impact: Charisiel is an elegant and unique name with roots in the ancient Hebrew language. It has been popular in various Christian communities, offering a beautiful reminder of God's grace and blessings.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Charisiel holds deep spiritual significance as it symbolizes the grace and blessings that come from God. It serves as a constant reminder of the divine love and mercy bestowed upon those who bear this name. Additionally, Charisiel can be seen as a reflection of the prayers and desires of parents who name their child with this name, expressing their hope for the child to grow in the grace and love of God.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Charisiel is a name derived from the Greek word "charis," meaning grace or favor, and the Hebrew word "El," meaning God. Thus, Charisiel can be interpreted as a divine being who embodies the grace and favor of God.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Charisiel was a 5th century Gaulish saint. The name Charisiel carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Gaulish saints were Christianized versions of pre-Roman deities.

modern_usage.modern_context: Charisiel is a unique and interesting name that may appeal to those seeking a rare and meaningful name for their child. Its historical roots as a Christianized Gaulish saint add an intriguing layer of meaning and cultural significance.

name_in_real_life.story: Grace Charisiel, a minister in Dublin, Ireland, shares that their name Charisiel meaning "Grace of God" has been a constant source of inspiration, guiding them to serve others and live according to Christian values.
